title: EmbeddingsToProcessTickets
description: The embeddings response to an embed_tickets_to_embedder request, as read by process-issues. Only the fields process-issues reads are described; every other field is allowed and ignored. A response that does not match, or whose indexes are not exactly 0 to n - 1 for n inputs, or whose vectors do not have the requested number of values, is an embedding failure: duplicate detection then fails open for the batch.

data.description: One entry per input, matched to its input by index (in any order).

index.description: The input this vector is for, counted from 0.
